app.label.descripcion: This is the website of a company dedicated to offering various health services to patients. With a great team of professionals, we can advise you and provide all the information so you can use our services with extensive national coverage.
app.card1.description: Did you know the human body has enough iron to make a small nail? While it may sound surprising, our organism is an incredibly complex and efficient machine. There's always something new to discover!
app.card2.description: Keep your well-being up to date. A healthy lifestyle not only improves your physique but also strengthens your mind. Small changes like a balanced diet and regular exercise can make a big difference. Invest in your health, invest in yourself!
app.card3.description: Your health is our priority. At SuSalud, we offer a wide range of medical services with the highest quality and national coverage. Our team of professionals is ready to advise you and provide the care you deserve. Visit us and discover how we can take care of you and your family!
app.testimonial1.text: “Thanks to SuSalud, I was able to access a specialist without leaving my city. Excellent care!”
app.testimonial2.text: “The process to schedule my appointment was quick and easy. I recommend SuSalud to all my friends.”

faq.q1.question: How do I request an appointment?
faq.q1.answer: You can request an appointment from the services section, suggesting the time that suits you best.
faq.q2.question: What specialties do you offer?
faq.q2.answer: We offer pediatrics, cardiology, dentistry, and more.
faq.q3.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
faq.q3.answer: You can view the list of your assigned appointments, along with their status, whether Approved, Pending, or Rejected.
faq.q4.question: Do you handle emergencies?
faq.q4.answer: No, for medical emergencies, please go to the nearest emergency room.
